description: 해양수산부_지능형해양수산재난정보체계_AIS정보 [disaster risk and hazard maps] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 해양수산부. 이 데이터는 해양수산부에서 AIS(자동선박식별장치) 정보를 수집하여 선박의 상태를 파악하고 관리하기 위한 목적으로 수집된 데이터입니다. 본 데이터의 주요 내용은 선박의 선박 번호, 선박명, IMO번호, 선박 길이, 선박 속도, 선수방위 등 선박의 운항 상태 정보를 포함하고 있습니다. 본 데이터는 선박 위... Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 해양수산부. Its tags are 해양정보, 선박정보, AIS통신망, 자동선박식별장치, 선박 번호. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2025-11-05 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
